notes.subject: bel
notes.rationale: לב i klostu long 'bel bilong tingting' long Tok Pisin, D4: NOGAT hat

notes.subject: נכמרו
notes.rationale: כמר i tok 'karim wantaim, pulap': KJV 'kindled', JPS 'stirred'; mi tanim 'i kamap klostu olgeta'

notes.subject: אמגנך
notes.rationale: מגן: 'skelim/skrapim yu ausait' (ASV) o 'paitim yu long banis' (KJV deliver); mi usim 'pulim yu kamap sef'

notes.subject: long Efraim na long Yisrael
notes.rationale: Yahwe i toktok daun long ol nem bilong ol, ol kwestin stret long ol

translation: Olsem wanem mi ken givim yu long ol arapela, Efraim? mi ken pulim yu kamap sef, Yisrael? Olsem wanem mi ken mekim yu olsem Adama? mi ken putim yu olsem Tseboim? Bel bilong mi i senis insait long mi, olgeta wantaim ol marimari bilong mi i kamap klostu olgeta.

tokens.gloss: mi ken givim yu long ol arapela
mi ken pulim yu kamap sef
